title: Selected Android device, approval cancellation and uncertain input recovery

categories.prompt: Stop phone activity while discovery, settings writes or approval are pending, then enable control again.

executableTestNames: keeps Stop last when it overlaps an earlier settings write
does not dispatch if Stop is pressed during device discovery
invalidates approved input across Stop and re-enable, while preserving receipt readback
cancels an open approval immediately when phone activity is stopped
does not take an approved screenshot after Stop and re-enable during review

categories.prompt: Hold input approval beyond the adapter deadline, then cancel before authorizing input.

executableTestNames: does not spend the adapter deadline while waiting for approval
releases the device resource when canceled before approval, without dispatch

categories.prompt: Observe a screen with busy accessibility data or missing, malformed or unreadable security XML, then request input.

executableTestNames: returns an approved screenshot when the accessibility tree is busy, without enabling input
keeps screenshot-only observations read-only when security or accessibility is unknown

categories.prompt: Change the screen pixels without changing the accessibility tree. For typing, change focus, text, target or surrounding pixels; separately allow caret paint inside the same focused native field.

executableTestNames: refuses changed pixels even when the opaque accessibility tree is unchanged
allows caret paint changes only for typing into the same focused native text field

categories.prompt: Restart after uncertain Android input, then attempt another operation on the same device and reconcile the original receipt.

executableTestNames: preserves unknown input and blocks a second task on the same device across service restart
verifies fresh domain criteria, keeps screenshots out of SQLite and never executes twice
does not claim verification from dispatch, wrong text or a missing receipt

notes: Scenario specification linked to executable Vitest regressions. This JSON is not loaded or graded by run_eval_suite.cjs and is not independent live capability evidence. The optional emulator scenario and separate Electron approval acceptance are documented in docs/android-phone-validation.md. No provider credentials or production profile data are required by the automated tests.
